**Job Description Summary

**This role works closely with R&D and requires a strong clinical background in cardiovascular ultrasound, including multiple years of hands-on scanning experience in a clinical environment. The individual serves as an important interface between clinical customers and engineering/product teams, bringing practical clinical expertise and an understanding of cardiovascular ultrasound workflows into product development.

The role focuses on identifying and translating user needs, workflow requirements, and clinical experience into actionable insights for R&D. The individual will develop and maintain specialized cardiovascular ultrasound expertise, remain current with evolving clinical practices and technologies, and contribute to product strategy, clinical validation, and best-practice development.

This is a global role, and we are offering flexibility in primary work location and working hours. The new colleague will, however, be expected to travel globally about 50% of the time.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Serve as a clinical subject matter expert in cardiovascular ultrasound, leveraging significant hands-on scanning experience to represent clinical workflows, user needs, and customer experience within R&D and product development.

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and other cross-functional teams to translate clinical needs and workflows into meaningful product requirements and development priorities.

• Engage with clinical customers to understand current workflows, unmet needs, usability challenges, and opportunities for innovation.

• Maintain and continuously develop specialized knowledge of cardiovascular ultrasound, including emerging clinical practices, technologies, guidelines, and trends.

• Serve as a best-practice and quality resource, developing clinical materials and presenting recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

• Maintain a strong working knowledge of the competitive cardiovascular ultrasound landscape and clinical factors that differentiate products and workflows.

• Apply clinical expertise and judgment to moderately complex problems, including clinical workflow evaluation, product development questions, customer feedback, and data interpretation.

• Support clinical evaluation and validation activities associated with new or evolving cardiovascular ultrasound technologies.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects and work collaboratively to build consensus and influence decisions.

• Act as a clinical resource and mentor for colleagues with less cardiovascular ultrasound experience.

**Qualifications

**

• Substantial hands-on cardiovascular ultrasound scanning experience within a hospital, health system, cardiac imaging laboratory, or comparable clinical environment.

• Registered/certified cardiovascular sonographer with demonstrated proficiency performing comprehensive adult echocardiographic examinations.

• Strong understanding of cardiovascular ultrasound anatomy, imaging techniques, clinical workflows, and best practices.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate clinical concepts and workflow requirements effectively to technical and non-clinical audiences.

• Master's degree preferred, but Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and significant relevant clinical cardiovascular ultrasound experience will be considered.

**Desired Skills

**

• Advanced cardiovascular ultrasound experience, including transesophageal echocardiography (TEE), intracardiac echocardiography (ICE), and/or structural heart procedures.

• Vascular ultrasound knowledge and experience.

• Experience supporting structural heart interventions or other advanced cardiovascular procedures.

• Experience working with physicians, sonographers, engineers, product teams, or other cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience translating clinical workflows and unmet needs into product or technology requirements.

• Knowledge of cardiovascular ultrasound equipment, post-processing applications, workflow solutions, and emerging technologies.

• Strong interpersonal, leadership, collaboration, and influencing skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate clinical information and develop recommendations.

• Experience leading clinical, research, product-development, or cross-functional projects.

• Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and other clinical, imaging, or collaboration technologies.

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, g ender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Behaviors

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Total Rewards

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Are you passionate about designing and improving global business processes?

Do you want to play a key role in enabling transformation by bringing deep domain expertise and driving process excellence?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to drive that transformation at scale.

We are strengthening our global process organisation and are building a Global Process Lead (GPL) layer across a range of end-to-end business processes spanning the full value chain—from planning and operations to finance, compliance, and product lifecycle management.

As part of this transformation, we are maturing our global processes, governance structures, and ways of working to support a more scalable and standardised operating model.

A key element of this journey is the implementation and rollout of core enterprise systems such as ERP, QMS, and PLM, enabling improved process consistency and integration across the organisation.

The role

As a Global Process Lead, you support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Ambu’s product design process. This includes mechanical design, electrical design, manufacturing process design and managing engineering data across these subprocesses and across our IT systems, primarily our PLM. Specific subprocesses within the PLM include creation of EBOM, translation of EBOM to MBOM and product master data management.

You play a key role in translating business needs into robust, scalable processes aligned with global standards.

Working closely with the Global Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts, technical workstream leads, and stakeholders across functions and geographical sites, you will contribute to process design, support implementation, and help ensure adoption of new ways of working.

This is a high-impact role where functional expertise meets cross-functional collaboration, and where you actively contribute to driving process excellence across Ambu.

Key Responsibilities

****Process design and domain expertise (primary focus)

**

• Ensure the design process integrates into the global product development process

• Provide deep functional expertise and ensure high-quality process documentation and standards

• Contribute to defining future-state processes and capabilities that allow our engineers to design products effectively, efficiently and in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the Design Processes that setup our engineers for success.

**Continuous improvement and execution support

• Identify and drive improvements that improve the product, reduce time to market and ensure regulatory compliance.

• Support implementation of process changes and ensure adoption across regions and sites

• Facilitate workshops and collaboration across functions to refine and improve processes

• Contribute to building a culture of continuous improvement

**Stakeholder collaboration

**

• Support communication and anchoring of process changes in the organisation

• Act as a key contributor in transformation initiatives and projects

• Ensure effective collaboration between global and local teams

**Suggested candidate profile

• A strong combination of functional domain expertise and an interest in process design and improvement

• Experience from a similar or related role in an industrial or global organization is preferred, especially from within the medical device industry

• Solid experience working with cross-functional processes and stakeholders in a global context

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in process design and documentation

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to engage stakeholders and support alignment across functions and regions

• A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with a continuous improvement mindset

• Willingness to travel regularly as part of a global role, supporting collaboration and implementation across Ambu’s footprint (including the US, Malaysia, China, and Mexico)

• Comfortable working across time zones, with flexibility to occasionally engage outside standard working hours

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

• 4+ years experience negotiating deals with a variety of C-Suite Executives to close opportunities

**Other Qualifications

For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. jobs.occupation: Part-time web developer (React/Django) for bioinformatic web tools - DTU Food
jobs.description:
DTU National Food Institute, Research Group for Genomic Epidemiology (Genepi), is looking for an independent part-time employee with interests in programming and software development to help us with support and maintenance of our bioinformatic web-tools. 

The position is not time-limited and is about 10-15 hours per week, on-site at DTU Lyngby with some flexibility. It suits an MSc student in Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

The job
Your tasks will include:

• Develop and maintain the frontend and backend of our web tools, using React and Django.
• Improve usability, responsiveness and visual consistency across the tools.
• Provide technical support: troubleshoot problems and answer user emails (mostly in English).
Our expectations of you
Required qualifications are:

• Hands-on experience building web applications with React (or a similar modern JavaScript framework) and Python/Django.
• Experience with Git and relational databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL).
• Real-world experience: at least one year of professional, freelance or substantial open-source web development.
• Experience with Linux servers or the command line.
• Able to take a task from specification to deployment on your own.
• Good written English.
The ideal candidate has an interest in UX/user-centred design and has familiarity with bioinformatics or our tools. This is not required, and we'll teach you the domain.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

You can find more information about the institute at DTU National Food Institute and the research group at Genomic Epidemiology

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is a part-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 4 December 2026. 

Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

Additionally, your application must include:

The Department of Physics and Astronomy (IFA), Aarhus University, Denmark (www.phys.au.dk) invites applications for a 2-year research assistant position with focus on establishing and maintaining trapped ion quantum technology setups. The work will partly be carried out in the newly established Quantum Tech-nology Lab (QTL) and within the Ion Trap Group.

The position is open from 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Your profile
The candidates are expected to have experience in cold trapped ion research, and hence both have experience in ion trap and laser technology. We are seeking enthusiastic candidates with a keen interest in setting up a new teaching ion trap setup in QTL as well as participate in maintaining and running ion trap experiments within the Ion Trap Group. More specifically, the candidate should have a solid background in construction and operating rf ion traps, CW laser systems including control of output powers, polarization states, linewidths and frequencies, as well as an understanding of analog and digital electronics for experimental control. Relevant methodology includes UHV vacuum handling, rf circuity electronics, laser frequency stabilization using optical frequency combs, rubidium atomic clocks, and GPS synchronization.

Applicants must be able to document relevant experience, as outlined above.

Who we are / The department
The Department of Physics and Astronomy is a department at the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark. The main objectives of the Department are to carry out research at the highest interna-tional level, to offer research based teaching at Bachelor of Science, Master of Science and PhD levels, and to exchange knowledge with other areas of society, e.g. by offering our expertise to industrial partners and the business world.

The Department is an attractive workplace for researchers, teachers, technicians, laboratory technicians and administrators and has a good study environment with many talented and active students at all levels. The research at the Department of Physics and Astronomy is of high quality, attracts significant international attention – in several fields the Department is within the world elite – and is characterized by many international collaborations with other high-ranking universities and research institutions around the world.

The place of work is Ny Munkegade 120, 8000 Aarhus C and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The successful candidate is offered
• a working climate inviting lively, open and constructive discussion within and across different fields of research
• a working environment with teamwork, close working relations, and social activities
• a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance
• a job where the overall environment in Denmark is family-friendly, safe and relaxed – contributing to Denmark consistently being voted amongst the happiest nations in the world.
 
Job description
Your tasks include:

• Establishing and running a novel linear rf ion trap setup for teaching purposes
• Handling existing CW laser systems including commercial external cavity diode laser systems, TiSa-lasers, fiber-lasers for trapped ion experiments
• Handling (electro-)optical setups for controlling the frequency and shaping the power level of CW laser
• Help developing experimental control systems based on the platform ARTIQ (ARTIQ)

Contact information
Further information can be obtained from Michael Drewsen (drewsen@phys.au.dk)

Deadline
The application deadline is 13 December 2026. 

Application procedure
Short-listing is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. Do you want to help keep the operational technology behind our wind assets reliable, resilient and ready for the future? We’re looking for an OT O&M Manager for Infrastructure to lead the services that enable secure connectivity, monitoring, control and operational data exchange across Business Area Wind.

OT infrastructure is the operational backbone of Business Area Wind. Every asset relies on it for secure connectivity, monitoring, control and the exchange of operational data.

We are looking for an OT O&M (Operation and Maintenance) Manager for Infrastructure within the OT team in Business Area Wind. This is an operational management role with end-to-end accountability for the performance, availability, reliability and continuous improvement of this business-critical service area.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every infrastructure domain. You do, however, need a strong understanding of OT environments and the ability to lead technical teams, challenge and support specialists, set priorities, make decisions and ensure that issues are driven through to resolution.

For this role, leadership, Accountability and Proactivity are as important as technical understanding. You will create the structure and momentum needed to deliver a reliable OT service.

The OT Infrastructure service area is responsible for the operation and maintenance of Operational Technology, including the hardware and software infrastructure that enables the flow of data between our enterprise network and our fleet of onshore and offshore wind farms. This includes central server infrastructure, such as asset data concentrators, data backup and restore solutions, and the supporting communication backbone, including Edge-to-Wide-Area connectivity solutions.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take end-to-end ownership of the OT Infrastructure service area and ensure that the hardware, software and connectivity supporting Business Area Wind’s assets remain reliable, resilient and available. You will set priorities for the service area, lead and develop technical teams, and establish clear governance for performance, costs, risks and lifecycle needs. A central part of the role is to shape the service strategy and roadmap while ensuring incidents, recurring problems and improvement needs are identified early and driven through to sustainable resolution. Working across OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Procurement, projects and suppliers, you will coordinate the expertise needed to manage critical operational dependencies and keep the service fit for future business requirements.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end accountability for the OT Infrastructure service area, including its performance, availability, reliability, cost and continuous improvement.

• Lead and develop the service area teams, setting clear priorities and expectations while empowering technical specialists to deliver within their areas of expertise.

• Drive operational performance, ensuring risks, incidents, recurring problems and improvement needs are proactively identified, prioritised and followed through to resolution.

• Own the service strategy and roadmap, including priorities, budget, resources, lifecycle needs and service development in line with Business Area Wind’s operational requirements.

• Provide effective operational governance, using service performance, risks, KPIs and technical input to make decisions and ensure clear accountability.

• Manage stakeholders and interfaces across Business Area Wind, bringing together OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Procurement, projects and suppliers to solve problems and deliver results.

• Ensure effective management of critical incidents and operational risks, providing leadership and escalation when required and ensuring lessons learned result in sustainable improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement, challenging existing ways of working where necessary and ensuring the service remains reliable, resilient and fit for the future.

Your profile

You combine a good understanding of OT infrastructure and operations with leadership experience from complex operational settings. You are comfortable taking Accountability for a business-critical service without needing to be the deepest technical expert in every infrastructure domain. Instead, you create clarity, set priorities and empower specialists to deliver, while remaining able to challenge recommendations and make informed decisions. With Proactivity, Collaboration, Composure and a Solution-Oriented approach, you provide direction during incidents and periods of operational pressure, bring stakeholders together and ensure agreed actions are completed. You are motivated by improving reliability, resilience and ways of working over time.

Next To This You Bring

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational management, O&M, IT/OT service management, infrastructure operations, engineering management or asset management, preferably within energy or another asset-intensive industry.

• Experience leading technical teams or services in a complex operational environment, with a track record of improving performance and driving issues through to resolution.

• A good understanding of OT infrastructure and operations, sufficient to lead technical specialists, understand risks and dependencies, challenge recommendations and make informed decisions.

• Strong service-management capabilities, including operational performance, incident and problem management, lifecycle planning, risk management and continuous improvement.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, suppliers and management.

• A relevant degree in engineering, technology, business or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.
